patterns.note: The site uses a high-contrast, two-tone color palette dominated by bright red and white, creating a bold and energetic feel.
A distinctive mirrored text effect is used for the primary brand logo, creating a unique visual identity.
The hero section dynamically transforms from a static, oversized logo to a full-width video playing in the background as the user scrolls down the page.
Product listings are presented in a clean, border-separated grid layout, maintaining a consistent visual structure across product displays.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a video background that is revealed or activated upon initial scroll, replacing a static brand element. This creates an immediate, engaging visual experience.
The brand logo utilizes a mirrored text effect, where the main text is duplicated and inverted directly below it, giving a strong, memorable graphic identity.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and large, centered headings, often with a distinct background color or a simple white canvas.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual anchors, contrasted with smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical spacing between sections, with a more dense, structured grid for product displays.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the mirrored text logo, which is then dynamically replaced by a video hero on scroll. This combination of a unique static brand mark and an engaging motion-triggered hero creates a memorable and playful first impression.
